meta.name: moltext
meta.description: Compiles web documentation into agent-native memory context using the Moltext Compiler.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页文档变成智能记忆，提升对话理解
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能记住你常看的文档内容
copy.tagline_en: Turn web docs into agent memory for better conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to remember your web docs

howto.what: 当你需要学习一个新库或工具时，Claude会用Moltext编译器将官方文档转化为结构清晰的Markdown文件，并读取其中的技术规格，从而直接为你提供精准的代码示例和API说明。
howto.when: 当你明确要求学习某个库、SDK或工具的用法，例如说出“帮我学习foobar库”时触发。

say.note: Claude会生成一个Markdown文件并阅读
获取原始文档结构，避免摘要丢失信息

howto.what_en: When you need to learn a new library or tool, Claude uses the Moltext compiler to convert official docs into a structured Markdown file, then reads it to provide accurate code examples and API details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to learn a library, SDK, or tool, e.g., "Help me learn the foobar library".

say_en.text: Compile the axios library docs using moltext
say_en.note: Claude generates a Markdown file and reads it

say_en.text: Use moltext to learn Python requests library
say_en.note: Get raw doc structure without lossy summarization
